about: The Chart Spec read into a Chart Definition (ADR-0320, ADR-0251, ADR-0253, ADR-0290, ADR-0300): what it reads from the tables it names, what the tool answers the AI, and each refusal with its path, from tests/ExChart.Engine.Tests/ChartSpecTests.cs.

cases.name: ADR-0320: a Chart Spec names its data's columns and becomes a Chart Definition
ADR-0320: an accepted spec is answered with the chart said in words, its thinned pixels and its gaps

expect.has: 1 point is missing, drawn as a gap.
No pixel holds more than one point.

cases.name: ADR-0254, ADR-0320: past the plot's pixels, the answer says how many pixels hold more than one point

expect.has: 1 pixel holds more than one point, and says its range.

cases.name: ADR-0254, ADR-0320: the answer counts the thinned pixels of every series

expect.has: 2 pixels each hold more than one point, and say their range.

cases.name: ADR-0320: the version is required

refused.message: version is missing: a Chart Spec says which version it is written in; this reader reads version 1.

cases.name: ADR-0320: an unknown version is refused, never read as the nearest

refused.message: version 2 is not known: this reader reads version 1, and never reads a spec as the nearest version.

cases.name: ADR-0320: a version written with a fraction is not the version, though it is the same number

refused.message: version 1.0 is not known: this reader reads version 1, and never reads a spec as the nearest version.

cases.name: ADR-0320: a version written as text is not the version

refused.message: version "1" is not known: this reader reads version 1, and never reads a spec as the nearest version.

cases.name: ADR-0320 (AI-Q4): every series writes its kind, with no default

refused.message: series[0].kind is missing: every series says what its numbers are: level, rateOverInterval, amountPerPeriod, observation, priceRange; there is no default.

cases.name: ADR-0320: a kind written as null is missing, refused by its path, never a crash

refused.message: series[0].kind is missing: every series says what its numbers are: level, rateOverInterval, amountPerPeriod, observation, priceRange; there is no default.

cases.name: ADR-0320: an unknown key is named, and a spec without numbers in it is not told it holds none

refused.message: series[0].color is not part of a Chart Spec: series[0] takes id, name, kind, data, x, y, open, high, low, close, volume, label, panel, axis, fromZero, step, colour, size, key, edges, tooltip, interval, xInterval.

cases.name: ADR-0320: numbers written in a spec are told a spec holds none

refused.message: series[0].values is not part of a Chart Spec: a spec holds no numbers, only the columns they are read from; series[0] takes id, name, kind, data, x, y, open, high, low, close, volume, label, panel, axis, fromZero, step, colour, size, key, edges, tooltip, interval, xInterval.

cases.name: ADR-0320: a spec holds no numbers; values written beside the columns are refused before anything is read

refused.message: series[0].values is not part of a Chart Spec: a spec holds no numbers, only the columns they are read from; series[0] takes id, name, kind, data, x, y, open, high, low, close, volume, label, panel, axis, fromZero, step, colour, size, key, edges, tooltip, interval, xInterval.

cases.name: ADR-0320: an unknown key of the spec itself is named with the keys a spec takes

refused.message: colour is not part of a Chart Spec: a spec takes version, title, axis, series, surface, notes.

cases.name: ADR-0320: a definition's refusal names the series by its index

refused.message: series[1]: 'Rate' takes a colour or a size from a column, which belongs to marks drawn one a row: an observation.

cases.name: ADR-0320: two series of one identity are refused at the second one's id

refused.message: series[1].id "rate" is series[0]'s too: each series needs an identity of its own.

cases.name: ADR-0320: an unknown kind is named, with the kinds that exist

refused.message: series[0].kind "line" is not a Series Kind: it is one of level, rateOverInterval, amountPerPeriod, observation, priceRange.

cases.name: ADR-0320: a Data Handle the host's lookup does not know is refused by name

refused.message: series[0].data "curves" is not known: name a Data Handle a capability returned.

cases.name: ADR-0320: a column the table does not have is refused, naming the columns it has

refused.message: series[0].y: "rates" has no column "yield"; its columns are date, rate, spread.

cases.name: ADR-0320: a value of the wrong type in a column is refused naming the row

refused.message: series[0].x: row 2 of "rates" holds "soon", but the axis is dates and needs a date.

cases.name: ADR-0251: a NaN is not a gap; the data says null for a missing value

refused.message: series[0].y: row 1 of "rates" is NaN, which is no number; a missing value is null, drawn as a gap.

cases.name: ADR-0251: an infinity is no number either

refused.message: series[0].y: row 1 of "rates" is -Infinity, which is no number; a missing value is null, drawn as a gap.

cases.name: ADR-0320: the definition's own refusal comes back with the series' path

refused.message: series[0]: 'Rate' is an Amount per period, which is always drawn from zero.
